ORE uses the microphone to dictate prompts into the composer. macOS transcribes it on this Mac when an on-device model is available, otherwise with Apple’s speech service. Audio is never sent to your agent provider.
ORE reads and writes the git repositories you add as projects. Grant access if you keep your code on an external drive.
ORE turns dictation into a prompt. Recognition prefers an on-device model and never goes to Claude, Codex, or Cursor.
